name: code-to-design
description: Capture any web page from Chrome and paste it into Figma as editable layers.

scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run build -w @c2d/extension && npm run build -w @c2d/figma-plugin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/figma-plugin/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/extension/src/capture/css.test.ts packages/extension/test/background.test.mjs packages/extension/test/capture.e2e.mjs packages/extension/test/modern-colors.e2e.mjs packages/extension/test/picker.e2e.mjs packages/extension/test/scroller.e2e.mjs packages/figma-plugin/test/import.e2e.mjs
